objs.name: information_object
objs.description: Object created to attach information to a document; used when attaching new information to documents.

objs.name: document
objs.description: Primary object representing documents such as policies, guidelines, and instructions.

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Abbreviation used in the document name to indicate the document type.

attributes.name: consecutive_number_per_type
attributes.description: Cross-client four-digit number assigned per document type.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: References that relate to the document (References attribute in properties).

attributes.name: areas_of_validity
attributes.description: Areas of validity for the document.

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: Document attachment not subject to the release cycle; used for supplementary information.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Tied to the main document; attachments released with the main document.

objs.name: equippment
objs.description: Attachment equipment associated with a document; has its own versioning.
